intro.text: One of the ten princedoms of Alethkar. Its colors are black and maroon, and its symbol is a chull.

items.text: When the Everstorm came, Kaladin flew from the Shattered Plains toward his family in Hearthstone but ran out of Stormlight over the Aladar princedom and walked the last ninety miles. Singer forces occupied the princedom in the first months that followed.
